title: Frog Jump II
sourceKind: search-snippets-only (official page returns 403 to WebFetch; statement taken from search-result summaries of secondary sites)
summary: Given sorted stone positions, the frog starts on the first stone, must reach the last one and return, using each stone at most once. The cost is the largest single jump; return the minimum achievable cost.
officialConstraints: Secondary summaries: up to 10^5 stones with positions up to 10^9 (not confirmed on the official page).
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps stones at 50 with positions up to 1000000. Examples [0,2,5,6,7] -> 5 and [0,3,9] -> 9 come from search summaries; not confirmed on the official page.
